description: Comprehensive Minecraft client/server features categorized by core, content, and util for session-10 implementation.

core.name: World map control profile v4
core.description: Unity map controller consumes v4 map-control profile and hydrates preview chunks with lake seepage-aware hydrology.

core.name: Hydrology/flow preview
core.description: Preview generator blends flow memory and lake seepage to match server-side hydrology masks around rivers/lakes.

core.name: Chunk load/unload management
core.description: Client manages chunk loading, unloading, and caching with view distance optimization.

core.name: Network packet handling
core.description: Client handles all network communication using protobuf-generated packet classes.

core.name: Player controller and state
core.description: Client manages player movement, actions, inventory, and game state synchronization.

core.name: Block break/place system
core.description: Client handles block breaking progress, placement, and interaction validation.

content.name: River/lake visualization
content.description: Render stitched river and lake overlays using the updated map-control profile hash/signature.

content.name: Terrain rendering and visualization
content.description: Client renders terrain chunks with proper lighting, water, and biome visualization.

content.name: Entity rendering and animation
content.description: Client renders mobs, animals, and other entities with proper animations.

content.name: Inventory UI system
content.description: Client displays player inventory, hotbar, and crafting interface.

content.name: Particle and visual effects
content.description: Client renders block break particles, explosions, and other visual effects.

util.name: Proto fingerprint guard
util.description: Client asserts EnhancedMinecraft proto fingerprints before building preview chunks.

util.name: StreamingAssets config sync
util.description: Data-driven world config and map-control JSON stay aligned with server signatures.

util.name: Data-driven asset loading
util.description: Client loads block and item data from JSON files for data-driven configuration.

util.name: Input validation and error handling
util.description: Client validates all user inputs and handles errors gracefully.

util.name: Performance monitoring and optimization
util.description: Client monitors FPS, memory usage, and optimizes object pooling.

core.name: Hydrology-aware terrain pipeline
core.description: Server hydrology/flow masks now apply lake seepage and edge normalization before carving rivers, lakes, and caves.

core.name: World map control profile v4
core.description: Map-control profile regenerated with lake seepage tuning and pipeline signature 2026-01-22-lake-seepage+proto-guard.

core.name: Chunk generation and management
core.description: Server generates, caches, and serves chunk data to clients with proper compression.

core.name: Network session management
core.description: Server manages player sessions, packet routing, and connection handling.

core.name: Player state and persistence
core.description: Server manages player data, inventory persistence, and state synchronization.

core.name: Block change validation
core.description: Server validates block break/place requests and broadcasts changes to nearby players.

core.name: World generation coordinator
core.description: Server coordinates world generation with proper seeding and biome distribution.

content.name: Cave stability tuning
content.description: Cave masks consume seepage-adjusted hydrology and retain edge sealing for rivers and lakes.

content.name: River generation system
content.description: Server generates realistic river paths with proper width, depth, and biome integration.

content.name: Lake generation system
content.description: Server generates lakes with proper depth, shoreline, and vegetation integration.

content.name: Mob spawning system
content.description: Server spawns mobs based on biome, time of day, and player proximity.

content.name: Crafting system
content.description: Server handles crafting requests and validates recipes against data-driven recipe database.

content.name: Inventory management
content.description: Server manages player inventory operations with proper item stacking and validation.

util.name: Enhanced proto validation
util.description: Handler bindings now fail fast when a generated prototype is missing, ensuring Google.Protobuf DTOs stay referenced.

util.name: Config/profile signature
util.description: Generation signatures include proto fingerprints and hydrology/lake seepage knobs for cache invalidation.

util.name: Data-driven configuration
util.description: Server loads all configuration from JSON files for data-driven behavior tuning.

util.name: Logging and diagnostics
util.description: Server provides comprehensive logging for debugging and performance monitoring.

util.name: Data persistence
util.description: Server handles saving and loading world and player data to persistent storage.

util.name: Performance optimization
util.description: Server optimizes performance with thread pooling and intelligent caching strategies.
